title: Stock Selloff Gains Speed on Ceasefire Doubts | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 3/26/2026
content: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec discuss the latest on US and Iran's back and forth as skepticism over a potential ceasefire grows, sending stocks lower. Bloomberg News White House and National Security Editor Michelle Jamrisko and Ann Miletti, Head of Equity Investments at Allspring Global Investments, both weigh in. Then, Tannenbaum Capital Group Founder Len Tannenbaum joins to discuss the latest in private credit as $5 billion worth of investor capital remains trapped behind withdrawal limits. Plus, Alicia Chong Rodriguez, Founder and CEO of Bloomer Tech, joins to discuss the company's smart bra that helps women track biometric data to aid in heart disease detection and treatment. (Source: Bloomberg)
